title: Kindle literal KEY=value configuration
description: Reference for parsed config.local.conf keys, not a JSON input file. calendar-config.sh performs runtime validation. Dynamic mode additionally requires image-auth.local.conf containing exactly one BEARER_TOKEN=value line (RFC 6750 b64token, max file size 4096 bytes).

IMAGE_URL.description: HTTPS endpoint without whitespace, control characters, backslash or authority credentials. Dynamic mode also forbids double quotes and fragments.

WIFI_SSID.description: Saved network name, 1..32 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.
